Entry.JapaneseText: せくしぃおねいさん
Entry.EnglishText: Sexy Big Sister
Entry.Notes: List on how to unlock each title with Rondoline https://aselia.fandom.com/wiki/ToP:NDX_-_Rondoline_E._Effenberg:_Titles

Entry.JapaneseText: お色気たっぷり、見せるのも惜しまないさっぱりした 性格もまた大人気。とても危険だ、気をつけろ！
Entry.EnglishText: Her sex appeal and easy-going personality make her quite the catch. She's also very dangerous, so watch out!

Entry.JapaneseText: 時空を越える女剣士
Entry.EnglishText: Time Traveling Swordswoman
Entry.Notes: Initial: available at the beginning

Entry.JapaneseText: 強い不思議な力を借りて、過去から現代へ彼女は飛ぶ。 時々響く切ない声は、彼女の心を哀しく映す
Entry.EnglishText: Borrowing a mysterious power, she leaps from the past to the present. The occasional wistfulnes in her voice reflects the sorrow in her heart.

Entry.JapaneseText: 再び時空越え女剣士
Entry.EnglishText: Time Traveling Swordswoman... Again
Entry.Notes: Event: Rejoining in Thor Nocte: This is Rondoline having traveled through time again

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔王を追い続ける執念は、時間をも越えてくる。 空回りの情熱の終着点は一体、どこにあるものか
Entry.EnglishText: Her obsession to pursue the Demon King transcends even time. Where will her aimless passion wind to next?
Entry.Notes: Trying to go for the double meaning by using "wind" - a reference to time as well as to where will she go next

Entry.JapaneseText: ありがとうさようなら
Entry.EnglishText: Thank You... and Farewell
Entry.Notes: Event: Defeat Dhaos twice Note: Could use Sayonara instead of Farewell

Entry.JapaneseText: 愛しいあの人の真実を知り、その変節の意味を知る。 それが彼との別れ、二度と会わない、永遠の別れ
Entry.EnglishText: She has learned the truth of her beloved and comprehends the reason for his turnaround. It is their final parting, an eternal farewell.
Entry.Notes:
Possibly running out of room, I didn't translate 二度と会わない b/c of the lack of space and repetitiveness with the other two phrases
I used beloved since that's the more literal translation, but context wise I believe it's referring to her father

Entry.JapaneseText: 旅の女剣士
Entry.EnglishText: Wandering Swordswoman
Entry.Notes: Event: Reach Level 10 Note: Used from Goodguy's translation

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル１０、とどまることを知らずさまよい続け、 旅を続ける。まだ真実は彼女から遠いところにある
Entry.EnglishText: Level 10. A title given to one who rarely stays put, who's journey continues ever onward. The truth remains far from her grasp.
Entry.Notes: Maxle's translation: She wanders without pause as her journey continues.

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔法剣士
Entry.EnglishText: Magic Swordswoman
Entry.Notes: Event: Reach Level 30 Note: Used from Goodguy's translation

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル３０、剣と魔法、双方を可憐に使いこなす。 器用貧乏と言われても、これが私の生きる道
Entry.EnglishText: Level 30. One who's capable of fighting with both spell and blade. She may be a jack-of-all-trades, but this is her chosen path.
Entry.Notes:
言われても - call, but I wasn't sure as whether to just say "Call her a jack of all trades". Might even be better to use "Deride" since it's implying that jack of all trades is a master of none
maxle's translation for first sentence: She wields both swords and magic with dexterity.

Entry.JapaneseText: スワローフェンサー
Entry.EnglishText: Swallow Fencer
Entry.Notes: Event: Reach Level 60 Note: Used from Goodguy's translation

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル６０、ツバメを想像させるすばやい攻撃が、 魅惑のエスカレーション。鋭いくちばしにご用心
Entry.EnglishText: At level 60, she bears the title of a fencer who's attacks strike so fast, one could mistaken them for a swallow! Better watch out for her beak!
Entry.Notes: Might need a better way to translate that last sentence to sound more natural; not sure how to describe her "beak" (to match the swallow bird theme they're going for here).

Entry.JapaneseText: イビルスレイヤー
Entry.EnglishText: Slayer of Evil
Entry.Notes: Event: Reach Level 100

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル１００、継承されたその刃に目覚め、邪を討つ。 視界に入ったターゲットは、決して見逃すことはない
Entry.EnglishText: At level 100, she has awakened the power to slay evil from the swords bequeathed to her. No target shall ever escape her sight!
Entry.Notes: I imagine it's referencing Dragunov

Entry.JapaneseText: 国士無双級の剣士
Entry.EnglishText: Peerless Swordswoman
Entry.Notes: Event: Reach Level 200

Entry.JapaneseText: レベル２００、この世に他に並び立つ者なし。いつか 誰かに追い越されるかも。だから、まだまだ修行中
Entry.EnglishText: At level 200, there is no one her match in this world. But someday, someone might surpass her, so she continues to train.

Entry.JapaneseText: 真実の愛
Entry.EnglishText: True Love
Entry.Notes: Sub-Event: 80: Rody & Dhaos -After entering the Crystal Trial Valley, return to Ethos's House, then reenter the Valley

Entry.JapaneseText: 時の狭間に消えた指輪だが、再びこの手に帰ってきた。 彼女と彼を時空を越えてつなぎ止める深き愛のしるし
Entry.EnglishText: The ring that was lost in that hole in time has somehow returned to her once more. It's a profound token of love that connects the two beyond time and space.

Entry.JapaneseText: エクリプスの子
Entry.EnglishText: Daughter of the Eclipse
Entry.Notes: Sub-Event: 66: Rody no Chichi 3 -Dhaos must be defeated -Subevent 47 must be completed -Talk to the wandering blacksmith in the garden in [AC. 4354] Ethos's House Note: Used from Goodguy's translation

Entry.JapaneseText: 世の裏側で暗躍する、蝕まれた月の一族の名を 知らない間に身につける。真実は父のみが知る
Entry.EnglishText: Unbeknownst to her, she bears the name of Eclipse, a clan of assassins that operates from the shadows. Only her father knows the truth.

Entry.JapaneseText: ダイナマイッ！
Entry.EnglishText: Dynamite!
Entry.Notes: Sub-Event: 50 Hot Spring (1) Note: Might better be translated as "What a Dynamite!" to indicate her attractiveness

Entry.JapaneseText: 毎朝一杯の牛乳を欠かさず飲む。それが大らかに 生きるヒケツ……いや、爆発級になるヒミツ
Entry.EnglishText: Every morning she never fails to drink a glass of milk. That's her secret to living large... no, to living explosively!
Entry.Notes: Want to double check the description translation

Entry.JapaneseText: 容赦なき手練
Entry.EnglishText: Merciless Trickster
Entry.Notes: Skit CT_004_127: 本当に怖いのは・・・ Note: Needs context of the skit to better see what "手練" is referring to

Entry.JapaneseText: 敵に情けをかけるのは、自分の実力に溺れる者。 謙虚な戦士は容赦なく、ボッコボコに叩きのめす
Entry.EnglishText: Showing mercy to the enemy is merely arrogance in one's strength. The truly humble show no mercy by beating them to a pulp.

Entry.JapaneseText: セクシーチャンピオン
Entry.EnglishText: Sexy Champion
Entry.Notes: Skit CT_004_150: チャンピオンロディ

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場の頂点に見事に立った超絶セクシー。 その姿態に見とれた戦士たちが大敗北とのウワサあり
Entry.EnglishText: She stands at the peak of the coliseum, her sexy form in full glory. Rumors abound how warriors mesmerized by her suffered crushing defeats.
